production.note: US model years 2015-2023. Previously recorded as calendar years 2014-2023: Dodge: production of the 2015 Challenger SRT begins at Brampton (Ont.) Assembly in the third quarter of 2014. End year: Challenger production at Brampton ended on 22 December 2023 (GM Authority, source gmauthority-challenger-end-2023). Model years 2015-2023.

body.note: Standard body. The Widebody is an option package and the Redeye, Demon, Super Stock and Jailbreak are separate variants.

transmission.note: Tremec TR-6060 manual standard, TorqueFlite 8HP90 automatic optional. Dodge's 2022 and 2023 spec sheets still list the manual as standard, but The Drive reports it was withdrawn from 2021 while the powertrain calibration was revised and returned for the final 2023 model year (https://www.thedrive.com/news/2023-dodge-challenger-srt-hellcat-gets-its-manual-back-finally).

powerHp.note: Rating for model years 2019-2023, five of the car's nine model years. Quote (Dodge 2023 specifications): "Power (SAE net) 717 bhp (535 kW) @ 6,000 rpm", "Availability Standard — SRT Hellcat". Dodge's 2019 fact sheet: "Challenger SRT Hellcat boasts a new rating of 717 horsepower and 656 lb.-ft. of torque" (source dodge-challenger-factsheet-2019). For model years 2015-2018 the rating was 707 bhp (527 kW) @ 6,000 rpm (source dodge-challenger-srt-specs-2015).

weightLb.note: 2023 model, standard body with the six-speed manual. Quote (Dodge 2023 specifications): "4,415 (2,002) — SRT Hellcat (manual)"; "4,422 (2,005) — SRT Hellcat (automatic)". The Widebody is 4,446 lb. The 2015 car was 4,449 lb with the manual and 4,439 lb with the automatic (source dodge-challenger-srt-specs-2015).
